name: vika
description: A local personal agent core with connector processes and an activity web module.

scripts.setup: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && node scripts/install-lark-cli.mjs && node scripts/install-slack-cli.mjs && npm run check:pi && npm run check:durable
scripts.check: for file in scripts/*.sh bin/pm2; do sh -n "$file" || exit 1; done && for file in scripts/*.mjs scripts/release/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/actions/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/connectors/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/extensions/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/meeting/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/qq/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/telegram/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/slack/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/weixin/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/email/*.mjs packages/daemon/scripts/*.mjs packages/web/src/*.mjs packages/web/scripts/*.mjs packages/web/public/*.js packages/updater/src/*.mjs packages/cli/src/*.mjs packages/cli/bin/*.mjs; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
